criterion: Strict <0.01 unrounded adjacent-window slope change and cross-process (max-min)/mean; each window R2>=.99; every point CV<=.05 and (P95-P5)/median<=.10
limits: CONTROL retains N-dependent empty-loop work, approximately 16 cycle/packet; raw and paired control-corrected domains are both required for active modes.

Control-loop work may be hidden by active loads/MMA. Subtracting CONTROL is a paired sensitivity comparison, not removal of an independently additive physical cost; do not interpret corrected BOTH/(corrected shader+corrected TC) excess as a physical overhead.
CTA duration is per-launch median of same-CTA end-begin, never cross-SM clock subtraction.
Done wait/poll can vary with N and runtime mode. These are completed-helper slopes, not isolated TC or shader instruction latency.
BOTH-minus-max does not identify a physical port. Source/TC counts and SYNCS/TRYWAIT/shared-misc evidence remain necessary.
